welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Birge is a place where mothers support each other. Say how you are in peace, find people who understand, and get help quickly. Choose your language: the whole app will use it.

inside.title: What is inside
inside.body: Three main things you can come back to at any time.

checkin.title: How am I
checkin.body: A short weekly wellbeing check-in. You see how you are doing over time.

circle.title: Circle
circle.body: Mothers nearby and by topic: chats, tea with someone who understands, useful listings.

help.title: Help
help.body: When it gets hard, the psychologist on duty will contact you. 112 is always one tap away.

privacy.title: Your data is protected
privacy.body: We take care of what you share.

jurisdiction.title: Stored in Kazakhstan
jurisdiction.body: Your data is stored on a server in Kazakhstan.

ai.title: An assistant that sees only what it needs
ai.body: The AI assistant gets only anonymized text, and only with your consent.

delete.title: You can delete everything
delete.body: Delete your account and all your data at any time in your profile.
